segments: Grab the setup you need and get back to the Easter Egg. The Ragnaroks are required for boss entry; the Shield is worth building early.
Seated corpse / desk in Clock Tower area
Lower side of Clock Tower stairs
Above the Rocket Test teleporter doorway
High on Pyramid metalwork / above a bow altar
Church, Gatehouse / above Double Tap, or the Undercroft.
Kill the first Panzersoldat and collect the dropped Ragnarok part.
Activate the Death Ray, then use the correct Wundersphere route to catch the floating part above the Bastion.
During a Rocket Test, arm the stair switch, survive in the bunker, then interact with the green teleporter console to spawn the part.
Take all three pieces to a workbench. Make sure every player has Ragnaroks before the boss-entry tiles.
Stand on all four Pyramid floor plates so anti-gravity cycles become available.
Move the three teleporter pieces into position early so weapon upgrades are ready before the boss.
